questions.title: Authentication for a SPA
questions.prompt: You're building a React SPA with a Spring Boot API on another domain. How would you implement authentication securely?
expectedConcepts: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies vs tokens in localStorage (XSS exposure)
CORS with credentials and an explicit origin allowlist
questions.answerOutline: Prefer HttpOnly session cookies, ideally same-site via a proxy, with CSRF tokens. Explain the XSS impact on localStorage tokens, CORS configuration, and the browser cookie policies that complicate cross-site setups.
commonMistakes: Long-lived JWTs in localStorage without discussing XSS
followUps: How do you authenticate a WebSocket?
questions.rubricNotes: 5: articulates the threat model (XSS vs CSRF) behind each choice.

questions.title: A slow page
questions.prompt: Users say a dashboard page is slow. Walk me through how you'd find and fix the problem across frontend and backend.
expectedConcepts: Measure: browser devtools, Web Vitals, network waterfall
Backend timing: logs, traces, DB queries
questions.answerOutline: Separate network, backend and render time; fix the biggest contributor first; verify with before and after measurements.
questions.rubricNotes: A systematic approach beats a list of tricks.
